paragraphs.text: Caztaca Huicintli is the apex priestess of the Threefold Sun in the Sun Empire on Ixalan .

Caztaca is the eldest daughter of Apatzec Intli III and sister of Atlacan Huicintli and Apatzec Intli IV . As she is much older than the boy-emperor and serves as his chief tutor, she is often referred to as his aunt. An especially tall woman, she is roughly the same height as Saheeli Rai . Severe, she wears fine, if muted, Sun Empire regalia and a broad helm of office.

Before its destruction in the New Phyrexian Invasion , Caztaca held dominion over Otepec . Intli III's first child, Caztaca developed a closer bond with with the priests of the Threefold Sun than with her father, when his son Intli IV was born shortly before 4 Dawn Era , Intli III named him successor instead of Caztaca.

After the invasion, the factions of the Sun Empire continued vying for power. A second Dawn Fleet was constructed in Queen's Bay, along with dozens of mechanoquetzacama (mechanical dinosaurs ), in preparation for an invasion of Torrezon . Hoping to prevent war, Caztaca plotted to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan and conspired with Saint Elenda of Garrano who hoped to subvert the rising faction under Vona de Iedo , the Antifex. Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions, agreeing to support their causes in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state in the ocean between the two.
